field.name: apportionment_formula
field.comment: SC uses single-sales factor apportionment (100% sales factor)

field.name: economic_nexus_threshold
field.comment: SC economic nexus gross receipts threshold: $100,000

field.name: license_fee_rate
field.comment: SC annual license fee rate: 0.1% (0.001) of capital and paid-in surplus

field.name: state_additions
field.comment: SC additions: federal interest income, certain expenses, IRC 199A addback, state income tax refunds, etc.

field.name: state_credits
field.comment: SC tax credits: job development, corporate headquarters, port volume increase, research and development, etc.

field.name: state_subtractions
field.comment: SC subtractions: SC municipal bond interest, state income taxes, state NOL, dividend income deductions, etc.

field.name: state_tax_rate
field.comment: SC corporate income tax rate: 5.0% flat rate - SC Code § 12-6-530

field.name: transaction_threshold
field.comment: SC economic nexus transaction count threshold: 200 transactions
